test_records.review_note: Only the actual Group Links owner source loader changed. All original assertion bodies remain and passed; no new full physical-read claim for the shared contract test.

fixes: Initial active/archive fetch failures no longer render empty-success messages or zero totals for unavailable data; each list retries independently.
Failed refreshes explicitly label retained saved rows and disable retry while replacement fetching is active.
Each successful copy receives its own full two-second confirmation; older timers and out-of-order failures cannot clear the latest feedback.
Abandoned clipboard operations cannot schedule post-unmount feedback; effect cleanup cancels the pending timeout.
A stable empty list identity preserves filter memoization during unavailable renders.
